note: M1 region registry (D-028). One region, one component: Header.tsx plus the styles it uses in dashboard.css. Hand-written from the real files, not derived automatically.

site-header.label: Site header
preserve: Every piece of header text and every link stays readable and reachable: the AI Earth home link, the fixture and review notices, Search, the "As of …" panel with all of its facts, Copy link, Reset.

Search keeps working the same way (typing, arrow keys, Enter, Escape) and keeps its label and combobox roles; the "As of …" disclosure still opens and closes; Copy link still copies and still announces the result.
An icon may stand beside a label, never instead of it — no control loses its visible text or its accessible name.
Nothing outside the header changes: the coverage line, the workspace, the rail, the footer and all data stay as they are.

interaction.label: the "As of …" panel opens and closes

site-header.notes: M1 (D-028): the header component and its styles may both be edited. No new dependency: this project has no icon library, it draws inline SVG (the brand mark in Header.tsx is one), so icons are inline SVG.
